ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) across approximately 85-90% of visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized to the distal tips and specific focal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white cluster located at the distal tip of the left lobe. Discrete circular white blobs mapped to the central ventral region. Right lobe displays diffused low-contrast gray mottling along the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 12% of the vertical bounding box of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern on the right lobe trailing edge with 7-9 distinct peaks (amplitudes ranging from 4-12 pixels). Left lobe edge is relatively smoother except for the distal tip which exhibits a jagged, multi-pointed termination.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a strong concave curve along the upper boundary leading to a sharp upward distal sweep. Right lobe presents a more linear, less-accentuated sweep toward the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of high-contrast white circular pixels at the extreme left lobe tip. Three isolated circular white pixel clusters visible in the mid-left lobe ventral field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast scarring at the left distal tip; irregular indentation on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 1/3 distance from the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, deeply recessed serration gap located immediately adjacent to the right side of the median notch.
